name: P-8 Poseidon (AI only)
summary: AI-only Boeing P-8 Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft for DCS World.
description: AI-only P-8 Poseidon from prcCOWBOY's collection, modified from the 737-800ERX, with 11 liveries (USA, Australia, UK, India, Norway, South Korea, Germany, blank). Carries AGM-84D/H and a placeholder LTF-5B torpedo loadout; listed in the Mission Editor as "P-8 Poseidon (CLP)". Built for DCS World 2.7.
